papers.title: Instruct2Act: Mapping Multi-modality Instructions to Robotic Actions with Large Language Model
papers.summary: Instruct2Act: LLM-written Python over SAM/CLIP/pick-place; VIMABench L1 avg 84.4 = VIMA-20M (copied baselines), no CaP baseline, prompt covers all eval tasks, L2/L3 figure-only; online/scoped. RS decompose_and_delegate/rs:C25 (+unify/rs:C18 weak); domain K105 partial.

papers.title: Asking Before Acting: Gather Information in Embodied Decision Making with Language Models
papers.summary: ABA: ask action + metadata ICL / ABA-FT; beats ReAct in ALFWorld and Ravens sim but only with an oracle-informed LLM informant and by-construction ambiguous variants; real-world part has no robot; online/scoped; RS outside_taxonomy; domain K108, K505 partial. Scope borderline (thin harness).

papers.title: Voyager: An Open-Ended Embodied Agent with Large Language Models
papers.summary: Voyager: curriculum + critic-gated code skill library + iterative prompting in Minecraft; 3 runs/method, strong component ablations, fresh-world unseen-task test; baselines authors-adapted; online/scoped. RS decompose_and_delegate/rs:C25 (+adapt_via_conditioning); domain K303, K105. Scope flag: virtual avatar via high-level API, no robot body.

papers.title: NavGPT: Explicit Reasoning in Vision-and-Language Navigation with Large Language Models
papers.summary: NavGPT: text-serialised views (BLIP-2/detector/summariser) + ReAct LLM on R2R val-unseen 783 eps, SR 34 vs trained 66, single run; no reasoning-trace ablation, depth gain within noise; cost not_reported; online/scoped. RS unify_into_shared_representation/rs:C18 partial; domain K109.

papers.title: Language to Rewards for Robotic Skill Synthesis
papers.summary: Language to Rewards: GPT-4 Motion Descriptor + Reward Coder -> MJPC; 90% vs 50% is best-of-10 oracle pass rate on 17 co-designed sim tasks, CaP baseline authored by proposers, real robot qualitative without counts; online/scoped. RS decompose_and_delegate/rs:C25; domain R01 partial.
